note: HTTP/2 frame payload bytes from the input are decoded into stream priority metadata used by the scheduler.
A recently closed stream record is allocated only large enough for stream_id and _scheduler while the scheduler openref can remain reachable through active scheduling state.
The scheduler reference for the reset stream is moved into the truncated recently-closed stream object.
The connection scheduler later walks active scheduler entries, including the relocated closed-stream scheduler.
The scheduler openref is converted back to an h2o_http2_stream_t pointer even when it points into the truncated closed-stream allocation.
The pending-data check reads fields beyond the truncated recently-closed stream allocation, causing the heap-buffer-overflow read.
